mapper.sql: id, user_id, client_type, device_id, device_name, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, status, last_active_at, signed_out_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_device_session (id, user_id, client_type, device_id, device_name, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, access_expires_at, refresh_expires_at, status, last_active_at, signed_out_at) VALUES (#{session.id}, #{session.userId}, #{session.clientType}, #{session.deviceId}, #{session.deviceName}, #{session.accessTokenHash}, #{session.refreshTokenHash}, #{session.accessExpiresAt}, #{session.refreshExpiresAt}, #{session.status}, #{session.lastActiveAt}, #{session.signedOutAt, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM auth_device_session WHERE access_token_hash = #{accessTokenHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM auth_device_session WHERE refresh_token_hash = #{refreshTokenHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM auth_device_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY last_active_at DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_device_session SET status = #{status}, signed_out_at = #{occurredAt}, updated_at = #{occurredAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE auth_device_session SET status = 'REVOKED', signed_out_at = #{occurredAt}, updated_at = #{occurredAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
